landing.title: Training planner and log for your dog
landing.heading: Plan and log your dog's training
landing.lead: Build a plan for each dog, schedule exercises across the week and write down how each session went. The history shows how your dog is improving.
landing.featuresLead: For handlers who train on their own or with a trainer.

plan.title: A plan for each dog
plan.description: Set up disciplines, goals and exercises the way you need them and change them whenever you like.

calendar.title: Weekly calendar
calendar.description: Exercises can repeat every week. Anything you don't get to, you move to another day.

log.title: Training log
log.description: Add a note to each exercise. It works on a phone right at the training field.

progress.title: Training history
progress.description: Your records stay in the history, so you can look back at them any time. When your dog masters a goal, you mark it as achieved.

landing.closingLead: Signing up is free. Once you're in, you can add your dog and set up a first plan right away.
